tasks.name: gather-facts
tasks.prompt: List 3 interesting facts about the Rust programming language. Be concise — one sentence per fact.

tasks.name: gather-opinions
tasks.prompt: List 3 opinions people commonly have about Rust. Be concise — one sentence per opinion.

tasks.name: synthesize
tasks.prompt: Write a short paragraph (3-4 sentences) that combines facts and opinions about Rust into a balanced perspective. Just write the paragraph, nothing else.
